policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="mcpTool" value="@{
   if (context.Request.Method != "POST" || context.Request.Body == null) {
    return "";
   }
   JToken body;
   try {
    body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
   } catch (Newtonsoft.Json.JsonReaderException) {
    context.Trace("MCP tool logging skipped: malformed JSON; request left unchanged.");
    return "";
   }
   var request = body as JObject;
   var parameters = request?["params"] as JObject;
   if (request?["method"]?.Type != JTokenType.String ||
    (string)request["method"] != "tools/call" ||
    parameters?["name"]?.Type != JTokenType.String) {
    return "";
   }
   return (string)parameters["name"];
  }" />
